Signature by agent1 with R = [r]B + T, T an order-8 point, and S = r + k*a mod L < L. It satisfies the cofactored equation [8][S]B = [8]R + [8][k]A but not the cofactorless equation encode([S]B - [k]A) == R, so it is rejected; a cofactored verifier would accept it.
